chunks: From the evil of the whisperer, the frequent retreater.

key_terms.الْخَنَّاسِ: The frequent retreater (who retreats when Allah is remembered)

ai.seo_question: What does 'Al-Khannas' mean in the context of seeking refuge from the devil?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'Al-Khannas' (the one who retreats) highlights the devil's intermittent nature, emphasizing that his whispers are most potent when the heart is heedless but recede during active dhikr. This attribute underscores the necessity of continuous spiritual vigilance, as the devil does not vanish permanently but merely withdraws to strike again when opportunities arise.
